prelaunch_updates.text: Official AMA Monday Nov 9 at 2:00 PM UTC (8:00 AM CT) with Foundation CEO Edgars Nemše and Discord co-host Hills. Graphic: ask the founders, catch the latest news, and claim a POAP live on the GenLayer portal. No TGE date, tokenomics, or token address in the post.

Venue official (@rhea_finance): Quantus ↔ NEAR QTC bridge now live at app.rhea.finance/bridge; QTC can move between Quantus and NEAR in seconds; yield from the existing qtc.omft.near pool. Quantus itself has not posted this yet. Bridge page loads a live UI.

Official: pSOQ trades on Solana and is built to bridge strictly 1:1 to SOQ at mainnet. The SOQ gateway runs on Solana devnet. Bitcoin, Ethereum and Cosmos gateways are planned. No official mint posted (pSOQ-on-Solana and Solana-devnet gateway were already logged Oct 23/31; planned extra-chain gateways are new). Separate post was a BT-Miners $30 coupon (partnership already known).

Official weekly update Sat 10:39 PM CT: network hashrate 1 PH/s; recap of Neoxa SOQ/USDC + Biconomy SOQ/USDT, SOQUPOOL→LuxxPool (stratum Wed 11/19 16:00 UTC), SoquShield TestFlight, and atomic swaps (BTC/LTC/DOGE/SOQ) in development. Separate official post: SoquShield v2.6.0 on Google Play (multi-wallet, hidden balances, screenshot/recording block). CoinGecko now indexes Biconomy SOQ/USDT (was missing through Sat 8 PM). Still no DEX / team disclosure.
Official Sat 11/7: "Devnet is out, Testnet date to be announced" (quotes Hayes: announce Testnet date next week; maximise earnings during Testnet / airdrop period). Devnet still no rewards.
Official: SIGMA Rome wrap (booth/QVRF awareness) + qwned quantum address exposure checker promo. Not a new campaign; Points still live; fee waiver still ends Sun 11/8.

Official Fri 11/6: at mainnet the Foundation will back validators with its own GEN; Pre-Mainnet Staking decides who gets those node seats. Season 2 points still open until mainnet. Launch day still undated.
CTO @rcarback at Bloccelerate Founder Summit Fri 11/6 NYC (quantum vs AI debate). Quip Points still live (points.quip.network). Fee waiver ends Sun 11/8.
SoquShield TestFlight update (multi-wallet, hidden amounts, UI). SOQUPOOL→LuxxPool merge timeline unchanged (stratum Wed 11/19 16:00 UTC).

Biconomy support page updated Wed 11/5: SOQ/USDT deposits Fri 11/6 11:30 UTC, trading/withdrawals 12:00 UTC. Restates Halborn audit + Wyoming Foundation; schedule unchanged vs earlier @soqucoin posts. Still CEX-only for DEX-only buyers.
